# Wend <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
Wend
```

## Description

Ends a [While](While) loop and goes back to test its condition.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
n = 0
While n < 2
	n = n + 1
Wend
Print n
```

```text
2
```
